articles.title: What Happened to Tech Stocks in 2000 That Many Investors Think Could Happen to Nvidia Today
articles.summary: Cisco was the indispensable infrastructure giant of its era, posting real revenue right up until its customers ran out of money and its stock collapsed 86%. Now credit markets are flashing a strikingly similar warning about Nvidia, and the reason has nothing to do with chips.

articles.title: What Cisco's Big Run Actually Adds To Your Portfolio
articles.summary: Cisco has outrun the market for years, yet what decides its place in your portfolio is how much of that return is genuinely its own.

articles.title: Cisco (CSCO) Joins AI Cybersecurity Alliance And Teams With Tech Mahindra On SSE
articles.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS:CSCO) has joined an industry coalition to launch the Open Source AI Cybersecurity Alliance. The company also announced a partnership with Tech Mahindra to deliver an AI driven Security Service Edge (SSE) offering for global enterprises. Cisco Systems sits at the intersection of networking, security, and AI, areas that are drawing increasing attention from enterprises looking to protect cloud based and distributed work environments. articles.title: Michael Burry Sounds Caution For Nvidia Again – Says It Could Echo Cisco’s Trajectory During Dot-Com Boom And Bust
articles.summary: “Shades of John Chambers,” Burry wrote in an X post about Nvidia, referring to the person who helmed Cisco during its boom years until the 2000 dot-com bust.
